summary: Radiopharm Theranostics filed a Form 6-K announcing a concurrent US$4.1 million registered direct offering of ADSs and a potential additional A$12.7 million Australian placement and share purchase plan. The U.S. offering involves 1,281,646 ADSs at US$3.16 per ADS to institutional investors, with warrants exercisable at US$3.79 per ADS expiring July 31, 2029, subject to shareholder approval. H.C. Wainwright acts as placement agent. The offering is expected to close July 28, 2026. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf registration, not a special situation.
